# Inside Prosper

> Local business directory for Prosper, Texas — discover the best restaurants, shops, fitness studios, professionals, and tradespeople in the community.

Inside Prosper is a community-driven directory showcasing the best local businesses in Prosper, Texas. Listings are curated and invitation-only, ensuring quality over quantity. The directory covers five categories: Food & Fun, Health & Fitness, Professionals, Shop, and Trades. Prosper is a fast-growing town in Collin and Denton counties, north of Frisco and south of Celina.

## Pages

- [Home](https://insideprosper.com/): Browse all local businesses by category
- [How It Works](https://insideprosper.com/#how-it-works): Learn how Inside Prosper features local businesses
- [Get Listed](https://insideprosper.com/#get-listed): Submit your business to the directory
